title: A Bell for the House
author: Quentin Delacroix
blurb: Theo Yarrow, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, has spent twelve years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the well refills.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
